subject: Permission to feature Avery Systems in Redwood win vignettes
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@averysys.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Permission to feature Avery Systems in Redwood win vignettes

Hi Kate,

Hope youre well — quick ask on behalf of the Redwood sales enablement team. Were pulling together a set of short "vignettes" (one-pager + slide snippets + 15-20s quote lines) to use in SDR/AE decks and a mid-market one-pager. Avery is a standout success on our mid-market play; with your OK wed like to: 

- Use the logo and a short customer quote on a one-pager and a slide 
- Include a 2-sentence impact blurb (well propose copy)
- Offer a heads-up if we might route a reference call to your team (wed only do this with prior approval)

I attached a draft one-pager for context (RW-onepager-draft-Avery.md). Would you be able to:

1) Confirm youre fine with the concept and receiving a short release?
2) Provide a single-line quote we can use (or let us draft and you approve)?
3) Share a high-res logo if available (PNG/SVG)?

If legal prefers their standard release, were happy to sign it. Target timeline: add to next weeks mid-market deck refresh (ETA Apr 10).

Thanks so much,

—Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: RW-onepager-draft-Avery.md (text/markdown)

From: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Systems Legal <contracts@averysys.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Permission to feature Avery Systems in Redwood win vignettes

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to help. Averys marketing team is fine with being featured, but legal needs a standard customer quote/release signed before we publish anything externally. Ive looped in our contracts team (CCed).

A couple items we can provide up front:
- A short approved quote: "Redwood helped us reduce inference cost per request while improving response consistency across peak loads." (we can shorten)
- High-res logo: sending separately once legal finishes the release

Please have your legal or enablement team send over the release and any examples of the final one-pager for sign-off.

Best,
Kate Johnson
Director, Product Operations
Avery Systems
kate.johnson@averysys.com

On behalf of Avery Systems Contracts: contracts@averysys.com

From: Avery Systems Legal <contracts@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@averysys.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Customer quote release - redlines

Hi Stephanie,

Attached is our standard Customer Quote Release with a couple of minor redlines (mainly around trademark usage and a 30-day notice before releasing any case study). Please review and confirm. We can sign as soon as both sides agree to the few edits.

Redlines summary:
- Section 2: add requirement for trademark guidance/usage guidelines
- Section 4: 30-day notice for any case study publication
- Section 7: limit on use of customer PII (we dont expect this applies)

We attached signed_release_draft.pdf with comments. If Redwood has a standard form, please send it for us to compare.

Regards,
Avery Contracts Team
contracts@averysys.com

Attachment: Avery_Customer_Quote_Release.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: internal: Avery vignette — redlines and next steps

Team,

Avery sent back their release with minor redlines (see attached from contracts). Contract asks for trademark guidance and 30-day notice for case studies. Kate indicated marketing is ok with a quote.

Quick plan: 
- Dylan: can you confirm were fine with a 30-day notice? We typically accommodate for strategic mid-market logos.
- Diego: Id like your take on the short impact blurb — Ill paste our draft below for edits.
- Lauren: once legal signs, please prep the single-slide hero (16:9) and the 1-pager variant — Ill push the quote into HubSpot.

Draft impact blurb (edit inline):
"Avery scaled Redwood to power real-time recommendation features for 120k monthly active users, reducing per-request inference costs by ~43% while meeting 99th percentile latency targets."

If were good, Ill propose our standard release back with Greenwood (legal) note and ask them to countersign. Goal: have signed release + assets by EOD Apr 05 so we can ship into Apr 10 deck refresh.

Thanks,
—Stephanie

(Internal only — no external recipients on this draft)

From: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Permission to feature Avery Systems in Redwood win vignettes

Stephanie,

All set on our side — legal signed the release (attached), marketing approved the shorter quote below, and Ive attached our logo (PNG). You have permission to use the quote and logo in the assets you described.

Approved one-line quote (please use verbatim):
"Redwood helped us reduce inference cost per request while improving response consistency during peak traffic."

Reference contact: Michael Park, Senior Engineering Manager (michael.park@averysys.com) — ok to pass to sales if needed for a reference call.

Attached: signed_release_Avery.pdf, Avery_Logo_RGB.png

Thanks for coordinating. Looking forward to seeing the final one-pager.

Best,
Kate

Attachment: signed_release_Avery.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Avery_Logo_RGB.png (image/png)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-06T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: Avery vignette — added to deck

All — signed release and logo received (see attachments). Ive dropped the approved quote into HubSpot and linked the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRW-Avery-onepager

Next steps:
- Lauren: final slide + one-pager by EOD Apr 07 (use approved quote verbatim)
- Dylan: add Michael Park as a possible reference for AEs — coordinate timing if a prospect asks
- Diego: quick QA on numbers in the impact blurb above and greenlight wording

Nice win — thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Stephanie

P.S. Ill schedule a 20-min sync if anyone wants to review the final slide before it goes live in the deck.
